name: The best parts for AI intelligence, assembled and proven
vision_statement: Anyone building AI intelligence can assemble a working system from the best open-source parts available, chosen by measurement and kept current every week, without writing the glue themselves.
opportunities: Any product that needs an AI grounded in a person or team's own goals can start from the assembled whole instead of researching and gluing parts again; a production consumer is the hardest test of the assembly.
solution_coherence: hub-of-hubs gives anyone a working AI assembled from measured open-source parts, and The Self is the whole that keeps its five kinds of part working as one. To respond to a request, The Self asks for the person's authority and preferences from Consciousness, asks where the system's data lives from Body, passes the request on for processing to Intelligence, and asks World how current the research is. The Self then keeps the run record in Body and asks Consciousness to learn from the person's feedback.
